name: Offroad Life 3D 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Offroad Life 3D is an exhilarating driving game that invites players to experience the thrill of life on the mountains with powerful offroad vehicles boasting huge wheels. Set against the backdrop of different seasons, from the vibrant colors of autumn to the warmth of summer, players navigate challenging terrains and discover various locations.
